title_zh: 国安部：唐某专程在飞机试验场旁小区高楼层偷拍尚未公开战机细节，上传网络后快速扩散
title_en: State Security Ministry: Man Photographed Undisclosed Fighter Jet Details from High-Rise Near Test Site and Uploaded Online, Sparks Rapid Spread
summary_zh: 国家安全部通报，唐某在飞机试验场旁小区高层偷拍尚未公开的战机细节，上传网络后快速扩散，危害国家安全。
summary_en: The Ministry of State Security (MSS) disclosed that a man surnamed Tang photographed undisclosed fighter jet details from a high-rise beside an aircraft test site and uploaded them online, causing rapid spread and endangering national security.
